title: Ledger
description: The completeness record of a review, of which there is one: one row per rule probed, naming what was opened, the verdict reached, [[Evidence]], and any [[Violation]]s

Observation.description: What the code does wrong, briefly, worded as the subject of the sentence '{observation} breaks {principle name}'. It names no rule and no principle, by name, id, link, or wording, and it says what is wrong, not how to fix it

RuleHeading.description: The heading of a rule in its ruleset

RulesetUrl.description: A ruleset from outside our rules, by its canonical URL

BookRule.description: A rule from outside ours, referenced by where it is read; no link is written into the observation

RuleRef.description: The rule broken: one of our rules by [[Id]], or an external rulebook rule

Violation.description: A finding that code on the [[Surface]] breaks a [[Rule]]: the rule id, the surface line id (idToReportViolationOn, omitted when the finding applies to the pull request as a whole), and the description of the violation

ViolationsList.description: Every finding on the rule when the verdict is violation

Examined.description: One thing opened to reach the verdict: a file, a symbol, a call site, a test file including the case where none exists, or a search with its query

ExaminedList.description: What was actually opened to reach the verdict. Context the probe needed and was not handed is named here rather than silently dropped

Evidence.description: Verifiable [[Evidence]] that the verdict rests on; the verdict it sits in says what it has to name

RuleViolationRow.description: A violation verdict reached on one of our rules by [[Id]]

BookRuleViolationRow.description: A violation verdict reached by the context probe on one rule of the ruleset it selected

RulePassRow.description: A clean or not-applicable verdict reached on one of our rules by [[Id]]

BookRulePassRow.description: A clean or not-applicable verdict reached by the context probe on one rule of the ruleset it selected

Row.description: One probe's result on one rule: a rule of ours, or a rule of a ruleset from outside ours

Rows.description: One row per rule probed: the rows of each probe in the order of its instructions

rows.evidence: Both scripts run under set -euo pipefail, and no step is wrapped in a construct that would let the script continue.
scripts/verify.sh:21 pipes the check into tail, so its status is lost.

violations.observation: Losing the check's exit status in a pipe into tail

rows.evidence: The change adds one check to a script and introduces no domain concept that could be left implicit.
